notes.subject: qetshane
notes.rationale: קצח: kumine ntsho kgahlanong le dithollo tse ding — lentswe le nyane la semela, le nkwe ka mokgwa wa sone

notes.subject: שורה
notes.rationale: mela kgahlanong le 'ya sehlooho' (KJV) — שורה ke mokotla, sengwe sa yona ke 'ka tekano'

notes.subject: נסמן
notes.rationale: bo tlotsitsweng — סמן e bolela ho kgetha/hoya ntle, eseng ho tlotsa ka boomo

notes.subject: ⟨di⟩
notes.rationale: Sesotho se hloka sedipuiso bakeng sa dithollo tse phallang

notes.subject: dithollo
notes.rationale: lenane la dithollo ka mekgwa ya tsona — korong, borele, speltete, kumine, qetshane

notes.subject: גבלתו
notes.rationale: גבולה le sehlomathiso — 'mollong wa yona' — sebopeho se seng sa lentsoe

translation: Ha e sa hlaha, ha a se a lekanisa sefahleho sa yona, a khutlisa ka mekhahlelo qetshane le kumine a di phalla, mme a beha korong ka mela, le borele bo tlotsitsweng, le speltete mollong wa yona?
